page.title: Analytics
page.description: What your agency actually earned, delivered and handled in cash over a period — every figure is what was credited, not an estimate.

range.label: Period
range.invalid: The end date must be on or after the start date.
range.tooLong: A period can be at most 366 days.
range.footer: Figures as of {{computedAt}} · days counted in {{timezone}}

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.description: Money credited to you for deliveries in this period. Dated when it was credited: at delivery for an online-paid order, at cash collection for cash on delivery.
earnings.netHint: Agency net {{agencyNet}} minus {{reversed}} reversed in this period.
earnings.netHintNoReversal: Nothing was reversed in this period.
earnings.feesEarnedHint: Before your agents' share. On a returned online-paid order this is the return fee.
earnings.codFeesHint: Kept whole — never shared with agents.
earnings.agentSharesHint: What your agents were credited out of those fees.
earnings.agencyNetHint: Fees earned − agents' shares + COD fees.
earnings.notSeparableHint: A cash-on-delivery run had no recorded delivery fee, so the COD fee can't be split out of it. The net below is still exact.

deliveries.title: Delivery outcomes
deliveries.description: Shipments that reached each outcome in this period, each counted once.
deliveries.returnedCodNote: A returned cash-on-delivery shipment earns nothing — no cash was collected.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.description: Cash is a liability, not income — it belongs to the platform until remitted, so it is kept apart from your earnings.
cod.owedNowHint: What you owe the platform at this moment, whatever the period.

perAgent.title: By agent
perAgent.description: Every agent with credited deliveries or collected cash in this period.
perAgent.empty: No agent delivered or collected cash in this period.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.lifetimeHint: Every payout ever paid to your agency, whatever the period.

empty: Nothing was credited, delivered or collected in this period.
